# Why

## Slides in a text editor

- The source lives in nvim
- The deck lives in a browser
- Keeping both in view is manual work

## The fix

- Move the cursor, and the slide follows
- Page the deck, and the cursor follows

# How

## Save to re-render

- Save, and quarto re-renders
- The page reloads on the same slide
- Nothing to click

## Inside herdr

- nvim on the left
- agent and page on the right

## Thank you
